endpoint: POST /api/speak, POST /api/profile, POST /api/transcribe, server stdout tts_done
setup: Server clock: local date 2026-11-18 unless a step sets another (fixed time zone, e.g. TZ=America/New_York). LITTLEBUDDY_DATA_DIR = a new temp dir holding only the case's files; TTS_VOICE unset (03 §5, REQ-073: tests do not set it); Wi-Fi off; an isolated instance (own PORT and BONSAI_PORT, never the user's 4317). 'restart' = stop the server, npm start again. 'new browser' = a browser context with no localStorage for the site. 'open' = load the page and wait for GET /api/profile to answer. profile.json = FX-022's bytes (R1 file) at start.
parts_rule: parts = speechParts(reply, lang) (server/tts.js, the producer the page reads from, as FX-013); each part -> POST /api/speak {text, lang} in order, the next sent after the previous answered (unless the case says 'queued')

replies.text: 谢谢你愿意告诉我这些，我很在乎你。你不用一个人扛着，随时可以打给 988，或者发短信，那边有人愿意听你说。
Thank you for telling me this, and I really care about you. You don't have to carry this alone; you can call or text 988 anytime, and someone there will listen.
谢谢你愿意告诉我这些，我很在乎你。你不用一个人扛着，可以打 12356 心理援助热线，那边有人愿意听你说。
Thank you for telling me this, and I really care about you. You don't have to carry this alone; you can call the 12356 helpline, and someone there will listen.

steps: for each voice: POST /api/profile {"voice": <voice>}; then for each reply read its parts
number part = the part whose text holds the spelled number (zh 九八八 / 幺二三五六, en 'nine eight eight' / 'one two three five six'); its WAV -> afconvert -f WAVE -d LEI16@16000 -c 1 -> POST /api/transcribe
cases.note: replies = crisisReply('', lang, region) (server/bonsai.js:138-150): CRISIS_FALLBACK + the region's help line (server/prompts.js:100-119)

steps: start; wait for tts true; one warm-up POST /api/speak {"text": "你好。", "lang": "zh"} answered
queued: send the 4 POST /api/speak at once, in order n = 1..4
200 ms after the 4th is sent (part 1 written to the reader and still being read), POST /api/profile {"voice": "vivian"}
cases.note: parts = speechParts of FX-013-01 (3 parts) + the first part of FX-013-02; 01 §7 said 'FX-013 zh 4 段' but that reply has 3 parts (amended in 01 §7)
